title: Attempted output bit
statement: Given a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $A$ over the Boolean alphabet and Boolean lists $x$ and $u$, the attempted bit is the bit extracted from the machine's halted run on $x$ with auxiliary input $u$, if that run yields an extractable bit; otherwise it is undefined.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
caveat: The supplied definitions do not specify the meanings of `haltRun` or `bitOfOutput`, so the exact run semantics and extraction behavior cannot be established from this payload.
